before.behavior: Destination warming used preloadBackgroundForSettings(), which could decode the currently effective Light/Dark wallpaper plus the inactive appearance variant.

after.behavior: Space intent and correctness-owned Space hydration use preloadEffectiveBackgroundForSettings(), which warms only the background that can be painted under the current resolved appearance.

structuralBaselinePreserved.note: Step 4B changes destination background preload scope, not DOM ownership; the small static-source increase is the effective-only helper and branch separation.

quickBenchmarkReference.note: Host-sensitive control only; Step 4B does not target state computation.
